title: Square (वर्ग)
trick: Diagonal diya ho to seedha Area $= \frac{d^2}{2}$ lagayein, side nikalne ki zaroorat nahi.

title: Rectangle (आयत)
back:
• Area $= l \times b$
• Perimeter $= 2(l + b)$
• Diagonal $(d) = \sqrt{l^2 + b^2}$
trick: Diagonal, $l$, aur $b$ hamesha Pythagorean Triplet banate hain (jaise 3-4-5, 5-12-13, 8-15-17).

title: Triangle — General & Heron's Formula (त्रिभुज)
front: Scalene Triangle (Sides $a, b, c$): Area & Semi-perimeter?
back:
• Area $= \frac{1}{2} \times \text{Base} \times \text{Height}$
• Semi-perimeter $(s) = \frac{a + b + c}{2}$
• Heron's Area $= \sqrt{s(s-a)(s-b)(s-c)}$
trick: Agar do sides ($a, b$) aur unke beech ka angle $\theta$ diya ho: Area $= \frac{1}{2}ab\sin\theta$.

title: Right-Angled Triangle (समकोण त्रिभुज)
front: Right-Angled Triangle (Base $b$, Height $p$, Hypotenuse $h$): Area, Inradius & Circumradius?
back:
• Area $= \frac{1}{2} \times b \times p$
• Inradius $(r) = \frac{p + b - h}{2}$
• Circumradius $(R) = \frac{h}{2}$
trick: Circumradius hamesha Hypotenuse ka half ($h/2$) hota hai.

title: Equilateral Triangle (समबाहु त्रिभुज)
front: Equilateral Triangle (Side = $a$): Area, Height, Inradius & Circumradius?
trick: Ratio yaad rakhein: $r : R = 1 : 2$, aur unke Areas ka ratio $= 1 : 4$. Agar height $h$ di ho to Area $= \frac{h^2}{\sqrt{3}}$.

title: Isosceles Triangle (समद्विबाहु त्रिभुज)
front: Isosceles Triangle (Equal sides = $a$, Base = $b$): Height & Area?
trick: Base $b$ ko aadha ($b/2$) karke Pythagoras se height nikalna formula ratne se fast hota hai.

title: Circle (वृत्त)
trick: Standard Table yaad rakhein: $r = 7 \Rightarrow C = 44,\ A = 154$. Radius $k$ guna hone par $C$ bhi $k$ guna aur Area $k^2$ guna hota hai.

title: Semi-Circle (अर्धवृत्त)
trick: Perimeter me $+2r$ (diameter) jodna mat bhoolna! Direct ratio: $r = 7 \Rightarrow \text{Perimeter} = 36$.

title: Sector & Arc of Circle (त्रिज्यखंड और चाप)
front: Sector (Radius = $r$, Angle = $\theta$): Arc Length & Area of Sector?
back:
• Arc Length $(l) = \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times 2\pi r$
• Area of Sector $= \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times \pi r^2 = \frac{1}{2} \times l \times r$
trick: Agar arc length $l$ aur radius $r$ diya ho to seedha Area $= \frac{1}{2} l r$ lagayein.

title: Parallelogram (समांतर चतुर्भुज)
front: Parallelogram (Sides $a, b$, Diagonals $d_1, d_2$): Area & Diagonal Relation?
back:
• Area $= \text{Base} \times \text{Height} = ab\sin\theta$
• Perimeter $= 2(a + b)$
• Diagonal Relation: $d_1^2 + d_2^2 = 2(a^2 + b^2)$
trick: SSC me $d_1^2 + d_2^2 = 2(a^2 + b^2)$ par direct question bahut aata hai.

title: Rhombus (समचतुर्भुज)
front: Rhombus (Side $a$, Diagonals $d_1, d_2$): Area, Perimeter & Side Relation?
back:
• Area $= \frac{1}{2} \times d_1 \times d_2 = a \times h$
• Perimeter $= 4a$
• Side Relation: $4a^2 = d_1^2 + d_2^2$
trick: Diagonals 90° par bisect karte hain, isliye $\frac{d_1}{2}, \frac{d_2}{2}, a$ hamesha Right-Angle Triplet banate hain.

title: Trapezium (समलंब चतुर्भुज)
trick: Parallel sides ka average $\times$ unke beech ki perpendicular distance ($h$).

title: Regular Hexagon (समषट्भुज)
trick: Regular Hexagon 6 identical Equilateral Triangles se milkar banta hai.

title: Circular Ring / Path (वृत्ताकार वलय)
front: Concentric Circles (Outer Radius $R$, Inner Radius $r$): Area of Ring?
back: • Area of Ring $= \pi(R^2 - r^2) = \pi(R + r)(R - r)$
trick: Hamesha $(R+r)(R-r)$ use karein — calculation seconds me ho jayegi.

title: Path Around Rectangle (आयत के चारों ओर रास्ता)
front: Path of width $w$ around a Rectangle ($l \times b$): Area of Path (Outside, Inside & Crossroads)?
back:
• Outside Path Area $= 2w(l + b + 2w)$
• Inside Path Area $= 2w(l + b - 2w)$
• Crossroads (Mid-path) Area $= w(l + b - w)$
trick: Outside me $+2w$, Inside me $-2w$, aur Crossroads me sirf $w(l + b - w)$.
